intraday.historical_split_rule: first 75% of complete session dates train; last 25% validation; persist before search

search.ranking: train mean net minus 0.00005 per additional condition; deterministic ties by rule ID

validation_gate: net expectancy > 0, PF >= 1.1, every validation year mean net > 0, net after top5 removal > 0, DD >= -20%, minimum sample met; intraday also positive at costs x2
execution: signal at bar close; entry next bar open; fixed horizon close or intraday session close; one position per ticker; no pending orders
boundary: purge all trades whose exit crosses split end; reset positions, not feature warmup, at validation start
drawdown: daily MTM fixed entry-notional 1/100 of initial equity per ticker, no reinvestment; diagnostic only, not final sizing
holdout_caveat: 2024-2025 already examined in V1. V2 excludes it from all fitting and ranking, but it is not historically virgin. Any KEEP remains a candidate requiring new prospective evidence.
